    (hred : ∀ h l₁ u g g' l₂, Good h (l₁ ++ (u, g) :: (-u, g') :: l₂) → g ∈ toSubgroup A B u →
      ∃ h' l', Good h' l' ∧ l'.length < (l₁ ++ (u, g) :: (-u, g') :: l₂).length ∧
        wprod φ h' l' = wprod φ h (l₁ ++ (u, g) :: (-u, g') :: l₂)) :
    ∀ h l, Good h l → wprod φ h l ∈ (of : G →* HNNExtension G A B φ).range →

name: TheoremA.Britton.isChain_of_no_pinch
statement:
theorem isChain_of_no_pinch : ∀ (l : List (ℤˣ × G)),

    l.IsChain (fun a b => a.2 ∈ toSubgroup A B a.1 → a.1 = b.1)
  | [], _ => List.IsChain.nil
  | [_], _ => List.isChain_singleton _
  | a :: b :: l, H => by
    rw [List.isChain_cons_cons]

    · by_contra hne
      have hb

name: TheoremA.Britton.pairList_decomp
statement:
theorem pairList_decomp : ∀ (m : List (G × G)) (l₁ l₂ : List (ℤˣ × G)) (a b : ℤˣ × G),
    pairList m = l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂ →
    (∃ m₁ p m₂, m = m₁ ++ p :: m₂ ∧ l₁ = pairList m₁ ∧ a = (1, p.1) ∧ b = (-1, p.2) ∧
        l₂ = pairList m₂) ∨
    (∃ m₁ p q m₂, m = m₁ ++ p :: q :: m₂ ∧ l₁ = pairList m₁ ++ [(1, p.1)] ∧ a = (-1, p.2) ∧
        b = (1, q.1) ∧ l₂ = (-1, q.2) :: pairList m₂)
  | [], l₁, l₂, a, b, h => by cases l₁ <;> simp [pairList_nil] at h
  | p :: m, [], l₂, a, b, h => by
    rw [pairList_cons] at h
    simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

      (u = -1 ∧ ∃ h : g ∈ B, (t ^ (u : ℤ) * of g * t ^ ((-u : ℤˣ) : ℤ) :

name: TheoremA.NF.red_altL
statement:
theorem red_altL : ∀ (a₀ : P false) (L : List (P true × P false)), AltOK L → Red (altL a₀ L)
  | a₀, [], _ => by
    unfold altL optF; split_ifs with h
    · exact red_nil
    · exact red_singleton _ h
  | a₀, [p], h => by
    have h1 : p.1 ≠ 1 := h
    rw [altL, altL]
    unfold optF
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro l hl
      split_ifs at hl with h2 h3 <;>
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.mem_cons,
          List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hl <;>
        rcases hl with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> assumption
    · split_ifs <;> simp
  | a₀, p :: q :: L, h => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩

    ∃ N : Submodule (ZG B) (FreeMod B (R.c (k + 1))), N.FG ∧ N ≤ R.S ∧
      ∀ s ∈ R.S, f (k + 1) s - g (k + 1) s ∈ N

name: TheoremA.exists_homotopy
statement:
theorem exists_homotopy (R : Res B k) (θ : B →* B) (f g : ∀ i, FreeMod B (R.c i) →+ FreeMod B (R.c i))
    (hf : IsChainLift R θ f) (hg : IsChainLift R θ g) :
    ∀ n, ∃ K : ∀ i, FreeMod B (R.c i) →+ FreeMod B (R.c (i + 1)),
      (∀ i (l : ZG B) x, K i (l • x) = hat θ l • K i x) ∧
      ∀ j, j < n → j ≤ k → HomEq R f g K j

name: TheoremA.assemble_decomp

name: TheoremA.decomp_single

name: TheoremA.out_mul_ι_bOf

name: TheoremA.ι_bOf
statement: theorem ι_bOf (e : E) : ι (bOf ι hι e) = (cosetOf ι e).out⁻¹ * e

name: TheoremA.ρ_single

name: TheoremA.compV_apply

name: TheoremA.ρV_apply

    rw [powFlat_cons]
    simp only [powFlat, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil]
    unfold FreeGroup.IsReduced
    exact List.isChain_replicate_of_rel _ (fun _ => rfl)
  | p :: q :: L, h => by
    rw [FreeGroup.isReduced_cons_cons] at h
    have ih := isReduced_powFlat k hk (q :: L) h.2
    rw [powFlat_cons]
    unfold FreeGroup.IsReduced
    rw [List.isChain_append]
    refine ⟨List.isChain_replicate_of_rel _ (fun _ => rfl), ih, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [head?_powFlat_cons k hk] at hy
    have hx' : x = p := by
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩

      ∃ B A, w = B ++ x.inv :: A ∧ ∀ y ∈ B, adj x.1 y.1
  | [], h => by
    have := h x.1 x.1 (inCol_self _)
    simp [proj, Valid] at this
  | y :: w, h => by
    by_cases hy : y = x.inv
    · exact ⟨[], w, by simp [hy], by simp⟩
    by_cases hx : y.1 = x.1
    · exfalso
      have := h x.1 x.1 (inCol_self _)
      simp only [proj, Valid, true_or, ite_true, List.filter_cons, hx, or_self, decide_true,
        List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at this
      exact hy this
    by_cases hadj : adj x.1 y.1
    · have h' : CanPop adj x (proj adj w) := by
        intro a b hc
        have := h a b hc
        rw [proj_cons] at this
        have hn : ¬ InCol adj y.1 a b := fun hy' => inCol_disjoint hG hadj hc hy'
        rwa [push_eq_of_not hn] at this
      obtain ⟨B, A, rfl, hB⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.restrictCode_eq
statement:
theorem restrictCode_eq (n z : ℕ) :
    restrictCode n z = ((decodeRawWordNat z).bind (down n)).map (up n)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.codeArg_encode_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem codeArg_encode_comp (f g : OracleCode) :
    codeArg (encode (comp f g)) = Nat.pair (encode f) (encode g)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.codeArg_encode_pair
statement:
@[simp] theorem codeArg_encode_pair (f g : OracleCode) :
    codeArg (encode (pair f g)) = Nat.pair (encode f) (encode g)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.codeArg_encode_prec
statement:
@[simp] theorem codeArg_encode_prec (f g : OracleCode) :
    codeArg (encode (prec f g)) = Nat.pair (encode f) (encode g)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.codeArg_encode_rfind
statement:
@[simp] theorem codeArg_encode_rfind (f : OracleCode) :
    codeArg (encode (rfind f)) = encode f

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.codeArg_lt
statement: theorem codeArg_lt {n : ℕ} (h : ¬ n < 5) : codeArg n < n

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.codeTag_eq_of_lt
statement: theorem codeTag_eq_of_lt {n : ℕ} (h : n < 5) : codeTag n = n

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.codeTag_lt
statement: theorem codeTag_lt (n : ℕ) : codeTag n < 9

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_four
statement: theorem decode_four : decode 4 = query

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_of_tag_comp
statement:
theorem decode_of_tag_comp {n : ℕ} (h : codeTag n = 6) :
    decode n = comp (decode (Nat.unpair (codeArg n)).1) (decode (Nat.unpair (codeArg n)).2)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_of_tag_pair
statement:
theorem decode_of_tag_pair {n : ℕ} (h : codeTag n = 5) :
    decode n = pair (decode (Nat.unpair (codeArg n)).1) (decode (Nat.unpair (codeArg n)).2)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_of_tag_prec
statement:
theorem decode_of_tag_prec {n : ℕ} (h : codeTag n = 7) :
    decode n = prec (decode (Nat.unpair (codeArg n)).1) (decode (Nat.unpair (codeArg n)).2)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_of_tag_rfind
statement:
theorem decode_of_tag_rfind {n : ℕ} (h : codeTag n = 8) :
    decode n = rfind (decode (codeArg n))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_one
statement: theorem decode_one : decode 1 = succ

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_three
statement: theorem decode_three : decode 3 = right

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_two
statement: theorem decode_two : decode 2 = left

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_zero
statement: theorem decode_zero : decode 0 = zero

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.encode_decode
statement: @[simp] theorem encode_decode (n : ℕ) : encode (decode n) = n

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_left
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_left (x : ℕ) : eval R left x = Part.some (Nat.unpair x).1

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_prec_succ
statement:
theorem eval_prec_succ (f g : OracleCode) (a n : ℕ) :
    eval R (prec f g) (Nat.pair a (n + 1)) =
      eval R (prec f g) (Nat.pair a n) >>= fun i => eval R g (Nat.pair a (Nat.pair n i))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_prec_zero
statement:
theorem eval_prec_zero (f g : OracleCode) (a : ℕ) :
    eval R (prec f g) (Nat.pair a 0) = eval R f a

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_query
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_query (x : ℕ) : eval R query x = chi R x

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_recursive
statement: theorem eval_recursive (c : OracleCode) : RecursiveIn (oracle R) (eval R c)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_right
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_right (x : ℕ) : eval R right x = Part.some (Nat.unpair x).2

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_succ (x : ℕ) : eval R succ x = Part.some (x + 1)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_zero (x : ℕ) : eval R zero x = Part.some 0

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.exists_code
statement: theorem exists_code {f : ℕ →. ℕ} (hf : RecursiveIn (oracle R) f) : ∃ c, eval R c = f

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.mem_eval_comp
statement:
theorem mem_eval_comp {f g : OracleCode} {x y : ℕ} :
    y ∈ eval R (comp f g) x ↔ ∃ z ∈ eval R g x, y ∈ eval R f z

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.mem_eval_pair
statement:
theorem mem_eval_pair {f g : OracleCode} {x y : ℕ} :
    y ∈ eval R (pair f g) x ↔ ∃ a ∈ eval R f x, ∃ b ∈ eval R g x, y = Nat.pair a b

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.mem_eval_prec_succ
statement:
theorem mem_eval_prec_succ {f g : OracleCode} {a n y : ℕ} :
    y ∈ eval R (prec f g) (Nat.pair a (n + 1)) ↔
      ∃ i ∈ eval R (prec f g) (Nat.pair a n), y ∈ eval R g (Nat.pair a (Nat.pair n i))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.primrec_codeArg
statement: theorem primrec_codeArg : Primrec codeArg

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.primrec_codeTag
statement: theorem primrec_codeTag : Primrec codeTag

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.recursiveIn_iff_exists_code
statement:
theorem recursiveIn_iff_exists_code {f : ℕ →. ℕ} :
    RecursiveIn (oracle R) f ↔ ∃ c, eval R c = f

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ascHNN_conj
statement:
theorem ascHNN_conj (b : B) :
    (t : ascHNN φ hφ) * of b * t⁻¹ = of (φ b)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.eval_hnnRelator
statement:
theorem eval_hnnRelator (ψ : PresentedGroup S ≃* B) (φ : B →* B) (i : Fin n) :
    (hnnRelator ψ φ i).eval = FreeGroup.of (Fin.last n) * FreeGroup.of (Fin.castSucc i) *
      (FreeGroup.of (Fin.last n))⁻¹ *
        (FreeGroup.map Fin.castSucc (hnnWord ψ φ i).eval)⁻¹

name: TheoremA.RelPres.exists_hnnWord
statement:
theorem exists_hnnWord (ψ : PresentedGroup S ≃* B) (φ : B →* B) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ w : RawWord (Fin n), ψ (PresentedGroup.mk S w.eval) = φ (ψ (PresentedGroup.of i))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnBaseAux_mk
statement:
theorem hnnBaseAux_mk (x : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    hnnBaseAux ψ φ (PresentedGroup.mk S x) =
      PresentedGroup.mk (hnnRelSet ψ φ) (FreeGroup.map Fin.castSucc x)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnBwd_t
statement: theorem hnnBwd_t : hnnBwd ψ φ hφ t = hnnStable ψ φ

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnFwd_of
statement:
theorem hnnFwd_of (x : Fin (n + 1)) :
    hnnFwd ψ φ hφ (PresentedGroup.of x) = hnnFwdGen ψ φ hφ x

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnPresentationEquiv_of_castSucc
statement:
theorem hnnPresentationEquiv_of_castSucc (i : Fin n) :
    hnnPresentationEquiv ψ φ hφ (PresentedGroup.of (Fin.castSucc i)) =
      of (ψ (PresentedGroup.of i))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnPresentationEquiv_of_last
statement:
theorem hnnPresentationEquiv_of_last :
    hnnPresentationEquiv ψ φ hφ (PresentedGroup.of (Fin.last n)) = t

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnRelator_mem
statement: theorem hnnRelator_mem (i : Fin n) : (hnnRelator ψ φ i).eval ∈ hnnRelSet ψ φ

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnWord_spec
statement:
theorem hnnWord_spec (ψ : PresentedGroup S ≃* B) (φ : B →* B) (i : Fin n) :
    ψ (PresentedGroup.mk S (hnnWord ψ φ i).eval) = φ (ψ (PresentedGroup.of i))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hom_ext_presentation
statement:
theorem hom_ext_presentation {H : Type*} [Group H] (ψ : PresentedGroup S ≃* B)
    {f g : B →* H} (h : ∀ i, f (ψ (PresentedGroup.of i)) = g (ψ (PresentedGroup.of i))) :
    f = g

name: TheoremA.RelPres.lift_hnnFwdGen_castSucc
statement:
theorem lift_hnnFwdGen_castSucc (x : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    FreeGroup.lift (hnnFwdGen ψ φ hφ) (FreeGroup.map Fin.castSucc x) =
      of (ψ (PresentedGroup.mk S x))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.lift_presentation
statement:
theorem lift_presentation {H : Type*} [Group H] (ψ : PresentedGroup S ≃* B) (χ : B →* H)
    (x : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    FreeGroup.lift (fun i => χ (ψ (PresentedGroup.of i))) x = χ (ψ (PresentedGroup.mk S x))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.IsEnumerator.noneEnum
statement: theorem IsEnumerator.noneEnum {m : ℕ} : IsEnumerator R (noneEnum : ℕ →. RawWord (Fin m))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.commRel_mem
statement:
theorem commRel_mem {r n : ℕ} {T : List Triple} {t : Triple} (ht : t ∈ T) (hi : t.1 < r)
    (hj : t.2.1 < r) (hk : t.2.2 < r) (a b : Fin n) :
    commRel (copyIdx r n ⟨t.1, hi⟩ a) (copyIdx r n ⟨t.2.1, hj⟩ b) ∈ diagExtraRels r n T

name: TheoremA.RelPres.commute_of_closure
statement:
theorem commute_of_closure (hs : Subgroup.closure s = ⊤) (f g : B →* H)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, Commute (f x) (g y)) : ∀ x y, Commute (f x) (g y)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.copyIdx_surj
statement: theorem copyIdx_surj {r n : ℕ} (x : Fin (r * n)) : copyIdx r n x.divNat x.modNat = x

name: TheoremA.RelPres.diagFwd_of
statement:
theorem diagFwd_of (x : Fin (r * n)) :
    diagFwd ψ r T (PresentedGroup.of x) = diagFwdGen ψ r T x

name: TheoremA.RelPres.diagRel_mem
statement:
theorem diagRel_mem {r n : ℕ} {T : List Triple} {t : Triple} (ht : t ∈ T) (hi : t.1 < r)
    (hj : t.2.1 < r) (hk : t.2.2 < r) (a : Fin n) :
    diagRel (copyIdx r n ⟨t.1, hi⟩ a) (copyIdx r n ⟨t.2.1, hj⟩ a) (copyIdx r n ⟨t.2.2, hk⟩ a) ∈
      diagExtraRels r n T

name: TheoremA.RelPres.diagramGroup_ι_rel
statement:
theorem diagramGroup_ι_rel (t : Triple) (ht : t ∈ T) (hi : t.1 < r) (hj : t.2.1 < r)
    (hk : t.2.2 < r) :
    (∀ g h : B, Commute (diagramGroup.ι r T B ⟨t.1, hi⟩ g) (diagramGroup.ι r T B ⟨t.2.1, hj⟩ h)) ∧
    (∀ g : B, diagramGroup.ι r T B ⟨t.2.2, hk⟩ g =
      diagramGroup.ι r T B ⟨t.1, hi⟩ g * diagramGroup.ι r T B ⟨t.2.1, hj⟩ g)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.diagramPresentationEquiv_of
statement:
theorem diagramPresentationEquiv_of (v : Fin r) (a : Fin n) :
    diagramPresentationEquiv ψ r T (PresentedGroup.of (copyIdx r n v a)) =
      diagramGroup.ι r T B v (ψ (PresentedGroup.of a))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.divNat_copyIdx
statement:
@[simp] theorem divNat_copyIdx {r n : ℕ} (v : Fin r) (a : Fin n) :
    (copyIdx r n v a).divNat = v

name: TheoremA.RelPres.enumRelators_copiesEnum
statement:
theorem enumRelators_copiesEnum {n : ℕ} (e : ℕ →. RawWord (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) :
    enumRelators (copiesEnum e r) = ⋃ v, FreeGroup.map (copyIdx r n v) '' enumRelators e

name: TheoremA.RelPres.enumRelators_diagEnum
statement:
theorem enumRelators_diagEnum {n : ℕ} (e : ℕ →. RawWord (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (T : List Triple) :
    enumRelators (diagEnum e r T) = diagRelSet (enumRelators e) r T

name: TheoremA.RelPres.enumRelators_foldEnum
statement:
theorem enumRelators_foldEnum {m : ℕ} (L : List (ℕ →. RawWord (Fin m))) :
    enumRelators (foldEnum L) = ⋃ f ∈ L, enumRelators f

name: TheoremA.RelPres.enumRelators_mergeEnum
statement:
theorem enumRelators_mergeEnum {m : ℕ} (f g : ℕ →. RawWord (Fin m)) :
    enumRelators (mergeEnum f g) = enumRelators f ∪ enumRelators g

name: TheoremA.RelPres.enumRelators_noneEnum
statement:
theorem enumRelators_noneEnum {m : ℕ} :
    enumRelators (noneEnum : ℕ →. RawWord (Fin m)) = ∅

name: TheoremA.RelPres.eq_mul_of_closure
statement:
theorem eq_mul_of_closure (hs : Subgroup.closure s = ⊤) (fi fj fk : B →* H)
    (hc : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, Commute (fi x) (fj y)) (hd : ∀ x ∈ s, fk x = fi x * fj x) :
    ∀ b, fk b = fi b * fj b

name: TheoremA.RelPres.eval_commRel
statement:
theorem eval_commRel {m : ℕ} (x y : Fin m) :
    (commRel x y).eval = ⁅FreeGroup.of x, FreeGroup.of y⁆

name: TheoremA.RelPres.eval_diagRel
statement:
theorem eval_diagRel {m : ℕ} (x y z : Fin m) :
    (diagRel x y z).eval = (FreeGroup.of z)⁻¹ * FreeGroup.of x * FreeGroup.of y

name: TheoremA.RelPres.finProdFinEquiv_symm_copyIdx
statement:
@[simp] theorem finProdFinEquiv_symm_copyIdx {r n : ℕ} (v : Fin r) (a : Fin n) :
    finProdFinEquiv.symm (copyIdx r n v a) = (v, a)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.lift_diagFwdGen_copy
statement:
theorem lift_diagFwdGen_copy (v : Fin r) (x : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    FreeGroup.lift (diagFwdGen ψ r T) (FreeGroup.map (copyIdx r n v) x) =
      diagramGroup.ι r T B v (ψ (PresentedGroup.mk S x))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.mem_diagExtraRels
statement:
theorem mem_diagExtraRels {r n : ℕ} {T : List Triple} {w : RawWord (Fin (r * n))}
    (hw : w ∈ diagExtraRels r n T) :
    ∃ t ∈ T, ∃ (hi : t.1 < r) (hj : t.2.1 < r) (hk : t.2.2 < r),
      (∃ a b : Fin n, w = commRel (copyIdx r n ⟨t.1, hi⟩ a) (copyIdx r n ⟨t.2.1, hj⟩ b)) ∨
      (∃ a : Fin n, w = diagRel (copyIdx r n ⟨t.1, hi⟩ a) (copyIdx r n ⟨t.2.1, hj⟩ a)
        (copyIdx r n ⟨t.2.2, hk⟩ a))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.mem_mergeEnum_iff
statement:
theorem mem_mergeEnum_iff {m : ℕ} (f g : ℕ →. RawWord (Fin m)) (w : RawWord (Fin m)) :
    (∃ k, w ∈ mergeEnum f g k) ↔ (∃ k, w ∈ f k) ∨ (∃ k, w ∈ g k)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.modNat_copyIdx
statement:
@[simp] theorem modNat_copyIdx {r n : ℕ} (v : Fin r) (a : Fin n) :
    (copyIdx r n v a).modNat = a

name: TheoremA.RelPres.HX_a_eq
statement:
theorem HX_a_eq :
    (of (Monoid.Coprod.inr (FreeGroup.of 0)) : HX x) = t * bHX x * t⁻¹

name: TheoremA.RelPres.HX_conj
statement:
theorem HX_conj (w : FreeGroup ℕ) :
    (t : HX x) * of (uHom G w) * t⁻¹ = of (vHom x w)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.HX_x_eq
statement: theorem HX_x_eq (n : ℕ) : baseHX x (x n) = wVal (bHX x) t (n + 1)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.baseHX_injective
statement: theorem baseHX_injective : Function.Injective (baseHX x)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.conjFam_injective
statement: theorem conjFam_injective {p q : Fin 2} (hpq : p ≠ q) : Function.Injective (conjFam p q)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.conjFam_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjFam_of (p q : Fin 2) (i : ℕ) :
    conjFam p q (FreeGroup.of i) =
      (FreeGroup.of p ^ i)⁻¹ * FreeGroup.of q * FreeGroup.of p ^ i

name: TheoremA.RelPres.map_wVal
statement:
theorem map_wVal {K K' : Type*} [Group K] [Group K'] (f : K →* K') (B T : K) (m : ℕ) :
    f (wVal B T m) = wVal (f B) (f T) m

name: TheoremA.RelPres.shiftHNN_conj_pow
statement:
theorem shiftHNN_conj_pow (i : ℕ) :
    (t : ascHNN shiftHom shiftHom_injective) ^ i * of (FreeGroup.of 0) * (t ^ i)⁻¹ =
      of (FreeGroup.of i)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.shiftHom_injective
statement: theorem shiftHom_injective : Function.Injective shiftHom

name: TheoremA.RelPres.snd_comp_vHom
statement: theorem snd_comp_vHom : Monoid.Coprod.snd.comp (vHom x) = conjFam 1 0

name: TheoremA.RelPres.thetaEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem thetaEquiv_apply (w : FreeGroup ℕ) :
    ((thetaEquiv x ⟨uHom G w, w, rfl⟩ : (vHom x).range) : QGrp G) = vHom x w

name: TheoremA.RelPres.uHom_injective
statement: theorem uHom_injective : Function.Injective (uHom G)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.uHom_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem uHom_of (i : ℕ) : uHom G (FreeGroup.of i) =
    Monoid.Coprod.inr ((FreeGroup.of 0 ^ i)⁻¹ * FreeGroup.of 1 * FreeGroup.of 0 ^ i)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.vHom_injective
statement: theorem vHom_injective : Function.Injective (vHom x)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.vHom_of
statement: @[simp] theorem vHom_of (i : ℕ) : vHom x (FreeGroup.of i) = vGen x i
